summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all core requirements: glob matching (**, *, ?, basename patterns), label assignment with priority resolution, config validation, CLI interface, and workflow structure. Strong edge case coverage (empty lists, no matches, priority ties, deeply nested paths, invalid JSON, file not found). Well-organized with clear fixtures and TDD comments. Minor gaps: some glob syntax edges untested (unicode, empty patterns), limited integration cases in act harness (2 cases vs potential edge scenario coverage), no stress/perf tests, and type-checking itself not explicitly validated. Would reliably catch most regressions.
